evidence.locator: README Requirements, Layout, Run your agents on a server, How the safe git model works, Status and Roadmap; License
evidence.finding: Documents Mac installation, per-task Git worktrees, parallel PTY agents, a user-hosted engine, a Lead chat, prompt-first task creation and Git operations. README License explicitly states GPL-3.0-or-later with a commercial alternative.

evidence.title: ateam packages/agents/src/registry.ts
evidence.finding: AGENTS has separate claude, codex and opencode entries, with native executable, login, session-resume and headless command definitions.

evidence.title: ateam packages/server/src/lead/tools.ts
evidence.locator: File header; toolsFor propose_task, propose_loop, send_message, read_task; createLeadTools
evidence.finding: Lead tools inspect the board, read and message tasks, and propose tasks or scheduled loops. The Lead cannot create/start a new task or loop itself; a human creates the proposal from a filled dialog.

evidence.title: ateam apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/FileDiffView.tsx
evidence.locator: FileDiffView useEffect, parseDiff, Diff viewType and Hunk rendering
evidence.finding: The component fetches raw git file diff text, parses it and renders actual hunks in split or unified Diff/Hunk components; binary files get an explicit no-textual-diff message.

evidence.title: ateam PRIVACY.md
evidence.locator: What we collect; AI features with your own keys; AI coding agents
evidence.finding: The policy states neither desktop nor iOS app sends analytics, telemetry or crash reports to Clawnify. Agent traffic uses provider accounts; optional OpenAI/OpenRouter features use the user key.

evidence.finding: The file contains the standard GPL version3 license text. The products actual or-later licensing choice and commercial alternative are stated explicitly in README License, rather than inferred from the how-to-apply template.
